header.running_head: 2. The Effects of the Qur'an and Hadith...

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “When Allah wishes to carry out a matter, the angels in the heaven flap their wings, trembling out of fear and awe of Allah's command. Allah's command is heard by the angels like the sound that arises when a chain is struck on a smooth rock. When the awe is removed from the hearts of the angels, they ask among themselves, one to another, “What did your Rabb command?' and they reply, “He commanded the truth, and He is truly the Most High, greater than all' ”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ رَحِمَهُ الله قَالَ: اِلْتَقَي عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ وَعَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاص ﵃ عَلَي الْمَرْوَةِ فَتَحَدَّثَا ثُمَّ مَضَي عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو وَبَقِيَ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يَبْكِي فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ: مَا يُبْكِيكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ؟ قَالَ: هذَا يَعْنِي عَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ كَبَّهُ اللهُ لِوَجْهِهِ فِي النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني في الكبير ورجاله رجال الصحيح مجمع الزوائد: ٢٨٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Salamah ibn Abdur Rahman ibn Awf (RH) says, “Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) and Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Al-As (RA) met on the hill of Marwah. The two of them talked for a while. Then Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) went away, and Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) remained standing there, weeping. A man asked him, “O Abu Abdur Rahman, why are you weeping?” He said, “That whoever has even a mustard seed's weight of pride in his heart, Allah will fling him face down into the Fire -
